Configuring retries

Every outbound call in the client library retries twice by default. The delay between attempts doubles each time.

Set the retry budget per client rather than per request. A shared budget is what stops a slow dependency from amplifying traffic.

Idempotency keys are required for any retried write. The library generates one automatically when you do not supply it yourself.
